title: バクシン的トレーニング……？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Desiring a speed fast enough to reign victorious over Nishino Flower, Sakura Bakushin O continues her training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While she suspects that I'm trying to make her a sprinter…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O shakes off her doubts and continues to trust in me! Onward to victory!
